messages.subject: Multilevel moderation
parts:
Hi all, 

I had a question about moderation in longitudinal data and am wondering if lavaan would be an appropriate package to use in my analysis; I see much about multilevel mediation, but not moderation.

I am analyzing a dataset of psychotherapy clients, and am looking to examine how reduction in symptoms between sessions is predicted by client-level factors that vary at the session level. I am particularly interested in if there is a moderation effect of a client-factor (perceptions of secrecy in session) on the therapist & client relationship, such that its predictive effect (better relationship, more symptom change) is attenuated by client secrecy. I also have several covariates (e.g., ratings of session "goodness"). 

I am trying to read the literature but what I am finding is mostly about moderation using a time-invariant predictor. I am not necessarily interested in detecting between & within-person differences, but simply harnessing the repeated measures to provide a more robust test of a possible moderation factor across psychotherapy sessions. 

I was wondering if anyone can point me in a good direction regarding how to approach handling data like this in lavaan. Thanks!
